AccountType.description: Phase 0 Specification, Account: the five types of the chart.

AccountView.description: An account as the commands and queries return it: its chart, number, name, type, control flag, status and version (R-API-02).

BlockAccount.description:
ACCOUNT.BLOCK (step 4 brief, item 2): Active to Blocked on the current version, with a reason of at most 500
characters that goes into the audit event's changes and the ACCOUNT_BLOCKED payload, with no column of its own
(D-69). Rejected under R-PP-05 while an active posting profile rule of any company references the account (D-56).

BusinessDate.description:
A calendar date in the company's time zone (R-TIME-01). Business dates come from the command, never from the
system clock, so a posting date or document date is reproducible.

ChartOfAccountsView.description: A chart of accounts header as the API returns it; the ETag is the version (R-API-02).

ClearSetting.description: SETTING.CLEAR (step 2 brief; D-58): inserts a Cleared row at the slot, so the level falls through; nothing is updated or deleted. Scoped like SETTING.SET (D-63, RR-102).

Code.description:
A business key: 1 to 40 characters from A to Z, 0 to 9, dash and underscore, stored uppercase
(Phase 0 Specification, Conventions). Uniqueness within the scope stated on the attribute is R-MD-05.

CompanyInfo.description:
The company as every later step reads it and as COMPANY.CREATE and COMPANY.UPDATE return it (brief, step 3 read
contracts; milestone 2 step 3): identity, its own party (D-64), legal data, base currency, time zone, fiscal year
start, chart, rounding, status and the version the ETag carries (R-API-02). payment_tolerance waits for Phase 2.

CompanyStatus.description: Company and Contact use only Active and Inactive (State machines, part 1).

CostingMethod.description: Phase 0 Specification, ItemCompany: the only value in v1 (R-INV-05); master data, never the cost state cache.

CountryCode.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code: two uppercase letters (Phase 0 Specification, Data types).

CreateAccount.description:
ACCOUNT.CREATE (milestone 2 step 4 brief, item 1; D-69): an account in a chart. The number is a Code, unique per
chart (R-MD-05), and with the chart fixed from creation (R-MD-06); the type and the control flag are fixed from the
account's first journal line or first posting profile rule in any company. Status Active at create. Installation
scope and Sensitive, because a chart may serve several companies (D-69, RR-52).

CreateChartOfAccounts.description:
CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS.CREATE (milestone 2 step 3 brief, item 1): the header of a chart, installation-level, so
companies can share it (Specification, ChartOfAccounts). The code is unique per installation (R-MD-05) and never
changes (R-MD-06). Installation scope (D-47, RR-52).

CreateCompany.description:
COMPANY.CREATE (step 3 brief, item 3; D-64, D-65): every attribute of the Specification's Company except
payment_tolerance (Phase 2). The rounding mode defaults to the company.rounding_mode setting definition when
left out; the VAT rounding level is required while D-10 is open. The command also creates the company's own
party from the legal name, organisation number, VAT number and country, numbered from the installation-level
PARTY series (D-64). Installation scope (D-47, RR-52).

CreateInventoryAdjustment.description:
INVENTORY_ADJUSTMENT.CREATE (step 7 brief): a Draft for the company in the body, which is the command's scope
(R-SEC-01). The currency is the company's base currency, set by the system; the draft reference is the document
id. A draft may be incomplete: the POST guards (reason code, at least one Open line, items Stocked and Active,
stock coverage, period open) run at posting in step 8.

CreateItem.description:
ITEM.CREATE (step 5 brief): creates the installation-wide Item and its ItemCompany row for the company in the
body, in one command (D-43). The company in the body is the command's scope (R-SEC-01). The item number is
stored uppercase; a duplicate is rejected with R-MD-05. Default sales and purchase units are not part of any
command in milestone 1.

CreateSite.description:
SITE.CREATE (step 3 brief, item 6): a site of the company in the body, which is the command's scope (R-SEC-01).
The code is unique per company (R-MD-05) and never changes (R-MD-06); the time zone is optional and must be an
IANA name (empty means the company's). A site has no status; its address waits for Address (D-55).

CreateWarehouse.description:
WAREHOUSE.CREATE (step 3 brief, item 7): a warehouse of the site in the body, in the company the body names. The
scope is built from the loaded site row (its company and its id), never from the company id in the body; a site
that does not exist or belongs to another company than the body names declares the body's company and is a 400
(`site_unknown`, `site_other_company`) stored as the key's result, never a foreign-key 500 (the RR-102
pattern of the settings). The code is unique per company (R-MD-05) and never changes (R-MD-06); status Active at
create. Making it the default moves the site's default (Specification, Organisation commands).

CurrencyCode.description: An ISO 4217 currency code: three uppercase letters. Every amount carries one (R-MON-01).

DeactivateAccount.description:
ACCOUNT.DEACTIVATE (step 4 brief, item 2): Active or Blocked to Inactive on the current version. Rejected under
R-PP-05 while an active posting profile rule references the account (D-56), and under R-DOC-01 while its lifetime
balance is not zero in any company (D-69).

DiscardInventoryAdjustment.description: INVENTORY_ADJUSTMENT.DISCARD (step 7 brief): Draft to Discarded on the current version; the row stays (R-DOC-06).

DocumentStatus.description: The system states of a kernel document (Phase 0 Specification, State machines part 2; R-DOC-01).

InventoryAdjustmentLineInput.description:
One line of an inventory adjustment draft as the client sends it (step 7 brief): the item (set up in the
document's company, D-43), a signed quantity in the item's base unit (positive adds stock, negative removes it),
the warehouse (the header's when left out), the stock status and, for inbound lines, an optional entered unit
cost. Lines are matched by line number, positive and unique in the request.

InventoryAdjustmentLineView.description: A line of an inventory adjustment as the API returns it; quantities and costs travel as strings (D-37).

InventoryAdjustmentView.description:
An inventory adjustment with its header, its reason code and its non-Cancelled lines, as every command and the
read return it. The document number is empty until posting assigns it (number on post); the version is the
ETag (R-API-02).

ItemCompanyView.description: The company's row of an item (D-43), as the API returns it.

ItemType.description: Phase 0 Specification, Item: only Stocked items create inventory entries.

ItemView.description: An item with the row of the company it was read or created in; decimals travel as strings (D-37).

LineStatus.description: Phase 0 Specification, DocumentLine.line_status. A line left out of an UPDATE becomes Cancelled; nothing is deleted.

LotTracking.description: Phase 0 Specification, Item: immutable after the first inventory entry.

MasterDataStatus.description: The shared master data lifecycle (State machines, part 1; R-MD-03: never deleted).

PermissionCodePair.description: One SodConflict row as SETTING.READ returns it: two permission codes one user may not hold together (R-SEC-02).

PostInventoryAdjustment.description:
INVENTORY_ADJUSTMENT.POST (step 8 brief; Sensitive permission): Draft to Posted on the current version. In one
transaction the posting service writes the inventory entries, the balanced journal entry, the cache updates,
the audit events and INVENTORY_ADJUSTED, or nothing (R-LED-05, R-LED-07). The guards of the state machine run
first (R-DOC-01, R-LED-04, R-INV-05), the stock and cost checks after their rows are locked (R-INV-03, R-LED-08).

ReactivateAccount.description: ACCOUNT.REACTIVATE (step 4 brief, item 2): Inactive to Active on the current version; no guard.

RequestScope.description:
The scope a command or query declares from its own data (Build Brief, Authorisation): a create command carries
the company in its body, a command on an existing record derives it from the record, an installation-wide one
declares installation scope. The pipeline authorises against it after the record is loaded, inside the
transaction, before any business logic; a request without a scope is refused (D-47).

RoundingMode.description:
How a midpoint is rounded (R-MON-02). The default is half away from zero; a company may configure half even
(D-10, Company.rounding_mode).

ScopeKind.description: Where a command or query acts: the whole installation, one company, or one site of a company (R-SEC-01, D-47).

SetSetting.description:
SETTING.SET (step 2 brief; D-58, R-SET-01): writes one value row for a definition at a level and target, version
current + 1 under If-Match (R-API-02; 0 for a slot with no rows yet). The target names the company (and site or
warehouse) the level needs. The scope comes from the settings scope resolver inside the transaction: an Installation
value declares installation scope (RR-52), a Warehouse value the warehouse's company and site (D-63, RR-102). A
history-bearing definition takes the caller's valid_from; a plain one refuses it.

SettingBacking.description:
Phase 0 Specification, SettingDefinition.backing: where a configurable default lives. Setting: a value row. Column: a
named column of an entity, changed only by that entity's command. Data: rows of an entity, such as the shipped
conflict pairs. Planned: the feature that reads it comes in a later phase (R-SET-01, D-58).

SettingLevel.description: Phase 0 Specification, SettingDefinition.levels: the levels a value may be written at, most specific last (R-SET-01).

SettingLevelState.description: The state of one level at the target: its current version (0 when no row), and the deciding row when there is one.

SettingReadView.description:
SETTING.READ's answer: the definition's shape, the effective value and its source, and the levels at the target.
A Data or Planned definition has no value type (D-63). A Data definition answers with source Data and its entity's
rows, read in the query's transaction: for security.sod_conflicts, the conflict pairs (R-SEC-02).

SettingSource.description: Where an effective value came from (Phase 0 Specification, SETTING.READ): a level, the definition's default, an entity's column, or the rows of a Data definition's entity (D-63).

SettingValueView.description: The row a write inserted (Phase 0 Specification, SettingValue); the version is the slot's new version (R-API-02).

SiteInfo.description: A site as the reader, SITE.CREATE, SITE.UPDATE and the site queries return it; the ETag is the version (R-API-02).

StockStatus.description: Phase 0 Specification, DocumentLine.stock_status: the stock a movement line touches.

TaxClass.description: Phase 0 Specification, ItemCompany: input to the tax rules (R-TAX-01).

TaxRoundingLevel.description: VAT rounding per line or per document total; the default is pending D-10.

UnblockAccount.description: ACCOUNT.UNBLOCK (step 4 brief, item 2): Blocked to Active on the current version; no guard.

UnitCode.description:
A unit of measure code: a UN/ECE Recommendation 20 code such as H87 or KGM, or an item pack code such as BOX
(Phase 0 Specification, UnitOfMeasure and ItemUnit). Same character rules as Code.

UpdateAccount.description:
ACCOUNT.UPDATE (step 4 brief, items 1 and 3; D-69, R-MD-06): name, type and control flag on the current version
(R-API-02), in Active or Blocked. The command takes no chart: a chart or number in the body that differs from the
stored one is rejected under R-MD-06 (account_chart_fixed, account_number_fixed), an equal one ignored. A type or
control flag change after the account's first journal line or first posting profile rule, in any company, is
rejected under R-MD-06 with the attribute's code.

UpdateChartOfAccounts.description:
CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS.UPDATE (step 3 brief, item 1): name and template on the current version (R-API-02). A code in
the body that differs from the stored one is rejected under R-MD-06; an equal one is ignored.

UpdateCompany.description:
COMPANY.UPDATE (step 3 brief, item 4; D-65, R-MD-06): the whole set of changeable attributes on the current
version (R-API-02). An attribute R-MD-06 has fixed is rejected with 422 and a code naming it; the code never
changes (a differing code in the body is rejected under R-MD-06, an equal one ignored). The company's own party
follows the legal name, organisation number, VAT number and country (D-64). Status changes come with step 7.

UpdateInventoryAdjustment.description:
INVENTORY_ADJUSTMENT.UPDATE (step 7 brief): the whole draft on its current version (R-DOC-02, R-API-02). Lines
are matched by line number: a new number inserts, an existing one updates, a line left out becomes Cancelled,
a cancelled number given again reopens the line with the new values; nothing is deleted. Id from the route; the
scope from the record.

UpdateSite.description: SITE.UPDATE (step 3 brief, item 6): name and time zone on the current version; the code never changes (R-MD-06).

UpdateWarehouse.description:
WAREHOUSE.UPDATE (step 3 brief, item 7): name and default flag on the current version; the site and the code
never change (R-MD-06). Setting the default moves it from the site's previous default, which gets its own version,
audit event and WAREHOUSE_UPDATED event; clearing it leaves the site without one. BLOCK and the rest of the
lifecycle come with step 7.

WarehouseView.description: A warehouse as the commands and queries return it: its site and company, code, name, default flag, status and version (R-API-02).
